name: task-runner
description: Run durable tasks one at a time with fresh sub-agents

tools.name: task_runner_create
tools.description: Create an ordered task list and start its first sub-agent.

tools.name: task_runner_start
tools.description: Start an existing durable task list.

tools.name: mark_task_completed

tools.name: request_task_review
tools.description: Pause the current task and request human review.
